t: Strong and durable laminated self-adhesive tape, designed for long-term identification. Offers excellent resistance to water, abrasion, chemicals, fading and temperature extremes. Ideal for smooth, rough, textured and powder-coated surfaces, offering up to 3 times more strength on textured surfaces than Brother standard tape. Can be used on consumer units, solar panels and patch panels.
b: For Use on Smooth & Textured Surfaces
